notes.title: Dionysus V3 and festivities!
notes.content: [p]     Hello fellow gamers, today is the day Dionysus receives its V3 Update! Along with the bug fixes and new feature, there will be a V3 sale, which is a Dionysus and Catsle Studios first. Now onto that new feature… [/p][p]Dionysus will be receiving a Character Selection screen so you can choose a skin, this allows me to add more content without taking longer. [/p][p]Also, About the update poll… [/p][p]The poll will end August 28TH and I will collect the data, and tell everyone what will be added. Thank you for reading and have a great day,[/p][p]Catsle Studios[/p][p][/p][p]PS: The V3 sale will start August 5th and go through August 12th[/p]

notes.title: Update 2 is Finally Glitch-less and here!
notes.content: [p]So, as you, random French person who bought my game and all you other readers may know, i have been struggling to get update V2 of Dionysus to work, but i finally was able to 100% fix it, i apologize so much for my difficulty to be a game dev and publisher.[/p][p][/p][p]Catsle Studios [/p]

notes.title: Dionysus First Update!
notes.content: [p][u][i][b]The first update[/b][/i][/u][/p][p]Hello fellow gamers! This is Catsle Studios telling you that Dionysus is getting its first update right now! This update will include the new Card Randomization feature, 2 new cards which include the slow enemies and plus one ball card. I will also throw in the new settings menu with the ability to adjust audio.[/p][p][u][i][b]August Update[/b][/i][/u][/p][p]Next August I will release a poll for a new update so stay tuned![/p][p]Catsle Studios[/p]

notes.title: Dionysus Releasing July 5th 4:00PM EST
notes.content: [p][u][i][b]Hello Everybody![/b][/i][/u][/p][p]         This is an announcement that Dionysus, the first Catsle Studios game, will release July 5th 4:00PM EST. You might look at the store page and see that Dionysus is listed as "Coming Soon" but that is something i cannot change. Dionysus will have many updates to come and I am so excited to share all of my ideas with you. [/p][p][/p][p]         If you have any suggestions for Dionysus, just comment about it on one of the posts I release. Thank you for your time, have a great day![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
